_readme: Hand-curated ONE-OFF timed events of a place that only posts a poster (e.g. on Instagram) and has no calendar page. To add one, append an object to `events`. Required: id (kebab-case, stable, include the year: never change it once published, it keys saved/hidden state), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, local Rome), time (HH:MM, local), city, url (an https page about the event or, if there is none, about the venue), summary (one honest line). Optional: venue, endTime (HH:MM; omit when unknown, no end is published), tags, category (primary category id), image, verified:false. Public venue data only: no personal notes. Past events are dropped by the crawler window; delete old ones when convenient.
